name: Framework roundtrip and runtime probe

js.append: (function(){try{var C=require('csharp'),D='@ROOT@/../../private/runtime';function norm(p){return C.System.IO.Path.GetFullPath(p).replace(/\\/g,'/').replace(/\/+$/,'').toLowerCase();}var expected=norm(C.System.IO.File.ReadAllText(D+'/expected-root.txt').trim()),runId=C.System.IO.File.ReadAllText(D+'/run-id.txt').trim();if(!/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(runId)){throw new Error('missing current run identity');}C.System.IO.File.WriteAllText(D+'/probe.json',JSON.stringify({status:'loaded',run_id:runId,observed_ms:Date.now(),save_root_matches:norm(C.UnityEngine.Application.persistentDataPath)===expected,working_directory_matches:norm(C.System.Environment.CurrentDirectory)===norm('@ROOT@/game'),unity_version:C.UnityEngine.Application.unityVersion,is_playing:C.UnityEngine.Application.isPlaying}));console.log('BBEE_FRAMEWORK_PROBE loaded');}catch(e){console.error('BBEE_FRAMEWORK_PROBE failed');}})();
